name: WorldClim 2.1 Global High-Resolution Climate Surface Grids
description: WorldClim 2.1 is an open database of high-resolution global weather and climate surfaces for 1970–2000 baseline conditions, developed by researchers at UC Davis and partners. Provided across four spatial resolutions from 30 arc-seconds (~1 km²) to 10 arc-minutes (~340 km²), WorldClim 2.1 contains spatially interpolated monthly minimum, mean, and maximum temperature, precipitation, solar radiation, wind speed, and water vapor pressure, alongside 19 standardized bioclimatic variables (BIO1–BIO19) widely employed in ecological niche modeling and species distribution projections.
